complex_single.scope: Median of paired AWE times against the selected INT8 competitor, using the 24-bit, 11-modulus Arm library. Each value measures the host wall-clock time of one synchronous call on device-resident operands (copies inside the call included). The comparison uses correctly-rounded sample counts, not the later native p95/max rule. Allocation, warmup, poisoning and reference checks are outside the measured calls. This is not a timing of the public 20/22/23-bit versions. The public 24-bit build has not been timed again.
